programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Owned and operated by the same caretakers of Old South Pittsburg Hospital, Harriman presents a unique opportunity for the team to delve further into the study of hospital phenomena.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: 1941, syv krigsfanger flygter fra den frygtelige sovjetisk Gulag-lejr. Igennem 11 måneder kæmper de sig over 6.500 km fra Sibirien over den glohede Gobi-ørken i Mongoliet og videre over Himalaya- bjergene.

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: Wonder Boys
programme.desc: En engelsk professor forsøger at håndtere sin kone, der forlader ham, ankomsten af hans redaktør, der har ventet på sin bog i syv år, og de forskellige problemer, som hans venner og medarbejdere involverer ham i.

programme.title: The Other Woman
programme.desc: En hjertevarm film om kærlighed, sorg og forsoning med Natalie Portman i hovedrollen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en meget succesfuld sælger, stresser over at få en stor handel. For at hjælpe hende skal hun slå sig sammen med Jonathan, der har travlt med at skabe en magisk jul til sin kæreste. Konflikten er givet, men noget andet begynder også at gry...

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Det store slag har sin begyndelse da helten Leonidas – kun bevæbnet med læderundertøj og en kappe – førersin gruppe af 13(!) krigere mod nord for at forsvare hjemlandet mod…

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: Himlen over Wenders krigshærgede Berlin er fyldt med engle i trench-coats, der usynligt bevæger sig rundt blandt menneskene og lytter til deres fortvivlede tanker og prøver at støtte dem.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: 'Cold War' er en passioneret kærlighedshistorie om to mennesker med meget forskellig baggrund og vidt forskellige temperamenter. De er helt forkerte for hinanden, men er alligevel via skæbnen dømt til at forblive sammen.

programme.title: Paradise, Hawaiian Style
programme.desc: Elvis portrays a pilot who runs a local charter helicopter service on the beautiful island of Kauai. A possible suspension of Elvis' pilot's license threatens to destroy his charter company along with all of his financial assets.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA agent, Bryan Mills, reddede for et år siden sin datter fra en brutal trafficking-mafia. Men intet er glemt og intet er tilgivet, for nu vil faderen til et af Bryans ofre have hævn.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den afdankede sherif i en lille by i Georgia, Ben Watts, bliver presset til hurtigt at løse en gidselsituation – og indser snart, at han er en brik i et større spil blandt byens skumle hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensionerede CIA-agent Robert kaster sig ud i en vovemodig redningsaktion af sin ærkefjendes enke, Sasha. Men snart konfronteres Robert med et velkendt ansigt, som han troede, han aldrig skulle se igen...

programme.title: Mutant X: vække igen
programme.desc: Holdet hjælper besætningen på en havforskningsstation, der er truet af et forhistorisk væsen, som man tidligere troede var uddødt.

programme.title: Mutant X: at han ikke bliver det
